Players Committee card image of [[Beaumont Kin]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “At same and related locations, deploy cost of opponent's characters may not be modified. If you have ten cards in Lost Pile, Force drain +1 here. Once during battle, may add Beaumont's power to another character present; Beaumont is 'hit.'” Uploaded unchanged.
